note: The maximum amount of time allowed for an activity, task, or event.

senses.m: The maximum amount of time allowed for an activity, task, or event
senses.pat: set/impose a time limit · within the time limit · exceed the limit
ex: The exam has a strict time limit.
Bài thi có giới hạn thời gian nghiêm ngặt.
You must finish the task within the time limit.
Bạn phải hoàn thành nhiệm vụ trong thời hạn quy định.

note: A device that automatically turns electrical equipment on or off at set times; also called a timer switch.

senses.m: A device that automatically turns electrical equipment on or off at set times
senses.pat: set a time switch · a programmable time switch · time-switch control
ex: The time switch turns the lights on at dusk.
Công tắc hẹn giờ bật đèn lúc chạng vạng.
They installed a time switch for the heating system.
Họ lắp công tắc hẹn giờ cho hệ thống sưởi.

note: A small fipple flute, often made of metal, used in Irish and other folk music; also penny whistle.

senses.m: A small fipple flute, often made of metal, used in Irish and other folk music
senses.pat: play a tin whistle · tin-whistle player · a traditional tin-whistle tune
ex: She played a dance tune on the tin whistle.
Cô thổi một điệu nhảy bằng sáo tin whistle.
The band uses a tin whistle in its folk arrangements.
Ban nhạc dùng sáo tin whistle trong các bản phối dân gian.

note: To overturn or tilt something so its contents spill; in British English, also tip something up.

senses.m: To overturn or tilt something so its contents spill
senses.pat: tip up a bucket · tip something up carefully · be tipped up
ex: He tipped up the box to empty it.
Anh nghiêng chiếc hộp để đổ hết đồ bên trong.
The chair tipped up when he leaned back.
Chiếc ghế bị ngả bật lên khi anh dựa ra sau.

note: Very thin, lightweight paper used for wrapping, decoration, or wiping; distinguish from facial tissue in some contexts.

senses.m: Very thin, lightweight paper used for wrapping, decoration, or wiping
senses.pat: wrap something in tissue paper · colored tissue paper · a sheet of tissue paper
ex: She wrapped the vase in tissue paper.
Cô bọc chiếc bình bằng giấy lụa.
The package was filled with colored tissue paper.
Gói hàng được chèn giấy lụa màu.

note: The main role in a play, film, or opera whose title names the character or role.

senses.m: The main role in a play, film, or opera whose title names the character or role
senses.pat: play the title role · cast someone in the title role · title-role performance
ex: She played the title role in the new opera.
Cô đảm nhận vai chính mang tên vở opera mới.
The actor was cast in the title role of the film.
Diễn viên được chọn vào vai chính mang tên bộ phim.

note: A bar of soap for washing the body or hands, as distinct from laundry soap; somewhat old-fashioned.

senses.m: A bar of soap for washing the body or hands, as distinct from laundry soap
senses.pat: a bar of toilet soap · scented toilet soap · use toilet soap
ex: The hotel provided a small bar of toilet soap.
Khách sạn cung cấp một bánh xà phòng tắm nhỏ.
She bought scented toilet soap at the market.
Cô mua xà phòng thơm ở chợ.

note: A set of tools for a particular task or for general repairs; figuratively, a collection of methods or resources.

senses.m: A set of tools for a particular task or for general repairs
senses.pat: a basic tool kit · keep a tool kit in the car · a digital tool kit
ex: He keeps a tool kit in the trunk of his car.
Anh để một bộ dụng cụ trong cốp xe.
The workshop gave students a tool kit for repairs.
Xưởng cấp cho học viên một bộ dụng cụ sửa chữa.

note: A small outdoor building used to store tools and garden equipment.

senses.m: A small outdoor building used to store tools and garden equipment
senses.pat: a garden tool shed · keep tools in the shed · build a tool shed
ex: The lawn mower is stored in the tool shed.
Máy cắt cỏ được cất trong nhà kho dụng cụ.
They built a tool shed behind the garage.
Họ dựng một nhà kho dụng cụ phía sau ga-ra.

note: A powdered preparation for cleaning teeth, used before toothpaste became common and still sold in some products.

senses.m: A powdered preparation for cleaning teeth, used before toothpaste became common and still sold in some products
senses.pat: use tooth powder · a tin of tooth powder · brush with tooth powder
ex: The antique shop displayed a tin of tooth powder.
Cửa hàng đồ cổ trưng bày một hộp bột đánh răng.
Some people use tooth powder as an alternative to paste.
Một số người dùng bột đánh răng thay cho kem.

note: A police officer who directs traffic or enforces traffic laws; informal.

senses.m: A police officer who directs traffic or enforces traffic laws
senses.pat: a traffic cop directs · ask a traffic cop · traffic-cop duty
ex: A traffic cop directed cars around the roadworks.
Cảnh sát giao thông điều tiết xe quanh công trường sửa đường.
The traffic cop stopped the bus to let pedestrians cross.
Cảnh sát giao thông dừng xe buýt để người đi bộ qua đường.

note: A large truck that pulls a separate trailer; terminology varies by region, including articulated lorry and semi-truck.

senses.m: A large truck that pulls a separate trailer
senses.pat: a trailer truck carries · trailer-truck driver · a long trailer truck
ex: A trailer truck delivered the building materials.
Một xe đầu kéo chở vật liệu xây dựng đến.
The trailer truck turned slowly at the intersection.
Xe đầu kéo rẽ chậm ở giao lộ.

note: A container for waste; US English. British English often rubbish bin or dustbin.

senses.m: A container for waste
senses.pat: throw something in the trash can · empty the trash can · outdoor trash can
ex: Please put the wrapper in the trash can.
Vui lòng bỏ vỏ giấy vào thùng rác.
The city placed new trash cans along the beach.
Thành phố đặt thùng rác mới dọc bãi biển.

note: A place or collection containing valuable or rare objects; figuratively, a rich source of information or resources.

senses.m: A place or collection containing valuable or rare objects
senses.pat: a treasure house of art · a treasure house of knowledge · museum treasure house
ex: The archive is a treasure house of local history.
Kho lưu trữ là kho tàng lịch sử địa phương.
The museum’s treasure house contains rare manuscripts.
Kho báu của bảo tàng có những bản thảo hiếm.

note: A game or activity in which participants follow clues to find hidden objects; also a search for valuable things.

senses.m: A game or activity in which participants follow clues to find hidden objects
senses.pat: organize a treasure hunt · follow clues in a treasure hunt · a family treasure hunt
ex: The children followed clues during the treasure hunt.
Bọn trẻ lần theo manh mối trong trò truy tìm kho báu.
The museum organized a treasure hunt for visitors.
Bảo tàng tổ chức trò truy tìm kho báu cho khách tham quan.

note: A major road forming part of a national route network, maintained by a central authority in some countries; British usage.

senses.m: A major road forming part of a national route network, maintained by a central authority in some countries
senses.pat: a busy trunk road · traffic on the trunk road · trunk-road network
ex: The village lies beside a busy trunk road.
Ngôi làng nằm cạnh một tuyến đường chính đông xe.
The trunk road connects the port with the capital.
Tuyến đường trục nối cảng với thủ đô.

note: To listen to or watch a broadcast; also to become aware of or responsive to someone or something.

senses.m: To listen to or watch a broadcast
senses.pat: tune in to a program · tune in at eight · tune in to someone’s needs
ex: Tune in to the station at eight for the interview.
Hãy bật đài lúc tám giờ để nghe cuộc phỏng vấn.
The manager needs to tune in to the team’s concerns.
Người quản lý cần chú ý đến những băn khoăn của nhóm.

note: To adjust an engine or instrument so it works or sounds correctly; also to prepare or improve something.

senses.m: To adjust an engine or instrument so it works or sounds correctly
senses.pat: tune up a car · tune up a guitar · tune up before the concert
ex: The mechanic tuned up the engine before the trip.
Thợ máy chỉnh động cơ trước chuyến đi.
The orchestra tuned up before the concert began.
Dàn nhạc lên dây trước khi buổi hòa nhạc bắt đầu.

note: A single bed of a standard size designed for one person; term common in North America.

senses.m: A single bed of a standard size designed for one person
senses.pat: a pair of twin beds · twin-bed room · sleep in a twin bed
ex: The hotel room had two twin beds.
Phòng khách sạn có hai giường đơn.
They booked a room with twin beds for the children.
Họ đặt phòng có hai giường đơn cho bọn trẻ.

note: A one-piece close-fitting undergarment, traditionally with a flap at the back; also called long underwear or union suit underwear.

senses.m: A one-piece close-fitting undergarment, traditionally with a flap at the back
senses.pat: wear a union suit · a thermal union suit · an old-fashioned union suit
ex: He wore a union suit under his clothes in winter.
Anh mặc bộ đồ lót liền thân bên trong vào mùa đông.
The costume included a vintage union suit.
Trang phục có bộ đồ lót liền thân kiểu cổ.
